title: Venue: package, occupancy, payback
description: Venue track. Package and rate, meals in the package, retreat weeks versus nightly letting, a payback spreadsheet that lies.

units.title: Occupancy: retreat weeks versus nightly letting

objectives.text: Compare rate models in the calculator and choose one that shares the risk of a short group on purpose
Price meals per guest per meal and fix the menu and deadlines in the contract
Compare a month's result with retreat weeks and nightly letting, accounting for seasonality and empty days
Find the mistakes in a payback model that inflate the return

checks.question: A full campus for 20, 12 came. The venue gets 36,000 and the leader is in the red. What does this risk for the venue?
options: A leader who lost money is unlikely to come back — the guarantee today scares leaders off tomorrow
The venue must refund the empty places
The leader gets a discount automatically
checks.explain: A full campus shifts the whole shortfall onto the leader. A model with a minimum shares the risk and keeps the relationship (u1, "What the venue chooses").

checks.question: Which of these is worth writing into the contract with a leader about meals?
options: Only the total for the week
The number of meals by arrival and departure dates, the price per meal per guest, options and the final menu deadline
Nothing: the chef will sort it out on site
Only a list of forbidden foods
checks.explain: Meals are a part of the package both sides describe the same way: the edges of the week, the price, options and the deadline (u2).

checks.question: In a model, a "vacancy rate" line rises from 30 % to 85 % and is multiplied into revenue. What is wrong?
options: Occupancy sits under a label meaning the share of empty nights, and one rising number hides seasonality
Occupancy cannot be used in a model at all
checks.explain: Vacancy is the share left empty, while occupancy is what multiplies into revenue. An honest model shows it by month (u3, "What occupancy is").

checks.question: In a model, "ROI" adds yoga package revenue with no teacher's costs. What kind of mistake is this?
options: Revenue booked as profit — the return is inflated
checks.explain: Revenue is not profit. Without the teacher's pay, the hall and marketing, "ROI" grows by the whole revenue (u4, mistake 2).
